message.content:
Now I understand the flow. The Reader calls `xmlXIncludeProcessNode` when it encounters an XInclude element. The XInclude processing loads text files and stores them in `ctxt->txtTab`. The text node is also set as `ctxt->incTab[nr]->inc` and gets added to the document tree. When the Reader continues reading and moves past the included text node, it can free the text node. But `ctxt->txtTab` still holds a dangling pointer to it.

Now let me understand how to trigger this. I need:
1. An XML document with XInclude processing enabled in the Reader
2. Two XInclude elements that reference the same text file (so the second one hits the `txtTab` cache path)
3. The Reader needs to free the first text node before the second XInclude is processed

Let me look at how the Reader frees nodes. Let me check `xmlTextReaderFreeNode` or similar:
